title: Implement project memory drift detection and repair
summary: Turn the existing verify direction into a practical drift workflow that detects stale memory references, orphaned records, and receipt mismatches, then reports repair actions without mutating state by default.
expectedFailureModes: Memory records reference files that no longer exist and cause agents to reuse stale context.
Repair logic deletes useful long-term records because it cannot distinguish stale facts from archived context.
Verification reads too much project state and becomes slow enough that agents skip it during sprint close.
nextAction: Design the drift report shape and add read-only checks before implementing mutating repair.
